rules: Never copy a headline or article body.
Unavailable signals receive zero points and must be listed as missing; never fabricate evidence.
Use the date, source URL and observed entity or issue for every freshness claim.
Count each source URL once and reject nouns observed on fewer than two discovery surfaces.
Rank nouns by unique-URL mention count, then independent-outlet count, then discovery-surface count.
Reject discovery items whose publication date is not the current run date.

routing.newsrooms: The two newsrooms use the latest RSS headlines as reporting topics, verify the underlying event, and write an original report.
routing.general_blogs: Convert the same verified signal into practical site-fit intent such as cost, method, eligibility, schedule, comparison or precautions.
